notes: Non-obvious source behavior: an empty query still produces one candidate, not zero. `inferredIntent` returns `.unknown` for an empty normalizedQuery, and the `.unknown` case in `scoreCandidate`'s intent switch (`if guide.family == .genericRouter || .unknownRouter { score += 20 }`) has no `score > 0` guard — unlike the `.mesh` and hint branches, which all require some score already accumulated. So generic-router (family genericRouter) gets +20 from nothing, becomes the sole candidate, and is excluded from its own fallback slot, landing on generic-mesh (next catalog entry) the same way the tie-break fixture above does. matchedDirectGuide is false because the sole reason is "unknown router fallback", not "exact keyword", and inferredFamilies is empty. Verified by running the literal Swift source — an initial hand-analysis wrongly predicted zero candidates for empty input.
